scope: Exact completed download and verified on-disk target bytes, with subsequent target attachment still unaccepted; original receipt unchanged.

downloadPolicy.mode: whole-file; same baseline session; no resume; reset-only retry

interpretation: The first full download completed without retry. The original baseline exited; the frozen 1.1.2 version and ASAR are independently verified on disk. The expected CDP endpoint refused the connection and none of the same-executable candidates owned the expected listening port. The one candidate can be a no-type helper; no actual browser/new browser PID was identified. Effective target profile and historical state were not verified. This does not establish product installation failure, and flags/User registry values do not establish target environment loss.
candidateProcessCountBoundary: The count filters the exact private executable path and excludes --type arguments only. A no-type ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE helper can be a candidate, so this count does not identify an actual browser or prove target restart.
